items.text: riders take the line that gets them to their stop first, or now and then just the first train that comes, so expresses and slower locals both get their share, and trams at street stops have no boarding cost
items.edited: riders take whichever train or bus gets them to their stop first, so expresses get their share, and trams at street stops have no boarding time

items.text: a high-speed, ferry or bus line's fare multiple row shows the kind's multiple, so you can see why it costs more
items.edited: fixed a high-speed, ferry or bus line's fare multiple showing 1.00x when its riders pay that kind's multiple

items.text: fixed the demand bubbles staying on screen after turning them off when the graphics context was lost
added georgia, armenia, azerbaijan and afghanistan
split the huge Muzaffarpur zone into Muzaffarpur, Hajipur and Samastipur, and drew Manila smaller, with San Pablo City and Lipa City as new zones around it
big airports draw ground trips from farther away, so more of incheon's trips come from seoul
added a switch in the line panel's stop list to make a stop boarding only or getting off only
added bookmarks to Community: a bookmark button on each network and a Bookmarked tab, kept with your account when signed in
added busways, a track type for buses only, built off the streets like tram track; any bus on one runs 60 km/h
on a computer, a game that runs out of memory while loading loads again by itself with fewer cores
added help panels for demand and effective time
items.edited: added a help panel for effective time, from the trip panel

items.text: fixed the map's hover staying up over panels
search finds towns anywhere in the world
community saves open paused with blueprints hidden, and leaving one you haven't changed no longer asks first
added a toggle to hide all blueprints
fixed removing single track being refused with a one-way warning
the station tool picks train or tram, BRT station or port; BRT stations snap to bus routes, ports no longer need a ferry line, and stations can go on open ground again with two clicks
items.edited: the station tool picks train station, tram stop, BRT station or port; BRT stations snap to bus routes, ports no longer need a ferry line, and stations can go on open ground again with two clicks

items.text: fixed searching while the game runs freezing the tab and stopping trains
fixed a line on full track keeping its old frequency after a new train count or headway
people walk up to 1 km to a bus stop, up from 600 m
the game uses 30-40 MB less memory on big networks like the tokyo real network
brt is built like a blueprint: click the upgrade on a bus line, its new lanes show on the map, and construct pays for them; built lanes get a thin dashed border
the map credits start folded into the (i) button
fixed the lines list hiding money on a narrow panel when other columns were off
added the Discord and leaderboards links to Community, and report is now a flag icon that asks which problem before sending
added the keihan main line and 18 other lines missing from kansai's and nagoya's real networks
when the train simulation stops working, the game says so and lets you leave to the menu
viewing a community network no longer calculates its trips unless you tick calculate trips, so it loads much faster
fixed changing a line whose two directions use different stops or track, which could make every edit fail and stop saving until a reload
added brt stations: place one with the station tool beside a road. only brt lines stop there, and people come to it from as far as to any station
the drop marker in the lines list starts at the group's indent when a line will go into a group
every stop on an auto bus line now counts for trips, so auto lines carry about a quarter more riders
the game uses about 60 MB less memory on big networks
brt lines on the same road share their bus lanes, paid for once with the upkeep split
a brt lane takes 60 buses an hour each way, and lines sharing a full lane run fewer buses
items.edited: a brt lane takes 100 buses an hour each way, and lines sharing a full lane run fewer buses

items.text: trips to islands with no road or flight show as no route in the city panel until a ferry or line carries them
a saved game no longer calculates its trips again after an update, unless the update changed how trips work
after an edit, lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated, about 10 s on a 2,000-station save instead of 40 s
items.edited: after an edit, lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated, about 10 s instead of 40 s on a 2,000-station save and 35 s instead of 75 s on the New York save

items.text: after an edit on a save with no quick first pass (the New York save), lines' riders start moving once the first period's trips are calculated, about 35 s instead of 75 s
loading a big game in chrome uses up to 200 MB less memory
fixed timetables having an express run through a local before the first station with passing tracks
a second change made soon after another starts calculating trips again at once, so two changes a minute apart on a big map are calculated in about half the time
the bus tool tints the ground in town, where BRT runs faster than a plain bus
buses speed up and slow down at stops instead of jumping to full speed
fixed commutes and outings across a zone line treating trams as trains, so a busy tram line there carries fewer riders
trams brake more gently and new tram lines stand 30 s at a stop, as trains do
items.edited: trams stand 30 s at a stop and brake like trains, so a stop costs a tram as much time as it costs a train

items.text: fixed trips home going missing at stations people only drive to
station upgrades, passages and station buildings now cost upkeep, 0.1% of their price per day: a waiting room is $5k per day and park and ride $20k
items.edited: station upgrades, passages and station buildings now cost upkeep, 0.2% of their price per day: a waiting room is $10k per day and park and ride $40k

items.text: fixed errand, leisure and school trips treating trams as trains, so a busy tram line carries fewer riders
items.edited: fixed trams being counted as trains for errands, outings and trips across a zone line, so a busy tram line carries fewer riders

items.text: each city downloads about 45% less data (new york 4.1 MB, was 7.6 MB)
BRT lines have their own fare multiple, and advanced fares shows only the boat sizes and BRT you use, in two columns
